crossRefs.note: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
